segments.name: The Children's Place U.S.
segments.description: Operates U.S. and Puerto Rico stores, e-commerce sites and U.S. wholesale business selling children's apparel, accessories and footwear.
segments.evidence: Included in The Children's Place U.S. segment are our U.S. and Puerto Rico-based stores and revenue from our U.S.-based wholesale business.

segments.name: The Children's Place International
segments.description: Operates Canadian stores and sells products and royalties through international franchisees, offering children's apparel, accessories and footwear.
segments.evidence: Included in The Children's Place International segment are our Canadian-based stores and revenue from international franchisees.

revenueModel.text: Shoppers pay for apparel, accessories and footwear bought in stores or online; franchisees pay for products and sales royalties.
revenueModel.evidence: We generate revenue from our franchisees from the sale of products and sales royalties.
